items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That was exactly what I was trying to say. Well, he'd have his records and these records would be Mamie Smith...

ctx.x: Well, I mean some people, everybody played the blues but some could put some feeling in them and make them mean something and others, it was nothing.
Well, thank you. That's what I was trying to say. That was exactly what I was trying to say.
Well, he'd have his records and these records would be Mamie Smith, Bessie Fletcher Smith, Sara Martin, Ma Rainey, you know.
